lines.zh: 我压低身子，沿着岩缝小跑。
lines.en: I keep low and trot along the rock seam.

lines.zh: 羽片在夜风里轻轻张着。
lines.en: My feathers lift slightly in the night wind.
My prints in the sand are shallow.
Three steps, then I stop and listen.

lines.zh: 干燥的灌木，正合我藏身。
lines.en: Dry scrub suits me for hiding.

lines.zh: 我贴着石壁走，影子很淡。
lines.en: I walk along the cliff. My shadow's faint.

lines.zh: 同伴跟在后面，隔开几步。
lines.en: Packmates trail behind, a few steps apart.
I go wide around the waterhole.
This quiet isn't right.
I sink low and slide forward.
Grit grinds under my toes.
The desert cools fast at night.

lines.zh: 我朝着有味道的那边去。
lines.en: I head toward the smell.

lines.zh: 风顺毛吹，我压低身子走。
lines.en: Wind at my back, I walk low.
I break into a trot, then stop.
Plenty of prey beneath these buttes.
I lie by the stone, still.
My ears turn to every sound.

lines.zh: 这么小的身子，得处处小心。
lines.en: A body this small needs constant caution.
I shake out my feathers.
The stars are bright. I watch a while.
I count where my packmates are.
That one's not yet half-dead. Not yet.
Sand in my feathers. Itchy.

lines.zh: 凯恩塔的干土，我闻得出。
lines.en: I can smell Kayenta's dry earth.

lines.zh: 惊了就逃，这是活下来的办法。
lines.en: Startle, then flee. That's how I've lived.

lines.zh: 我缩起一只脚，省点热气。
lines.en: I tuck one foot in to keep warm.
The desert night is busier than the day.
I tuck my head down a little.
Something's moving nearby. Small.
Waiting is the night's main work.
The clearing is too open; I keep to the edge.
You're far bigger than the day creatures.
I back off a step. Don't follow.

lines.zh: 幼崽在身后，我把脖子压低。
lines.en: My chicks are behind me; I lower my neck.
I daren't pass by your feet.
I'm this small. Even me?
Raise a hand and I'm ready to bolt.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的腿，估算远近。
lines.en: I watch your legs and judge the distance.

lines.zh: 血腥味顺风来，我歪了歪头。
lines.en: Blood scent rides the wind; I tilt my head.

lines.zh: 我低低叫了一声，是给同伴的。
lines.en: I give a low call. For the pack.
Don't go near the little ones.

lines.zh: 我的骨头细，这一下很重。
lines.en: My bones are thin. That was heavy.

lines.zh: 我一边叫一边往石缝里钻。
lines.en: I cry out and squeeze into the rocks.
The pack heard. They're coming.
A feather came loose.
I'm dragging a leg.
It hurts too much to open my eyes.
I pull in under the stone.
That knocked the voice out of me.
I'm up. I can still run.
Don't come. I'll bite.
That meat fell at a good moment.
I come close, then stop.
It smells fresh. Worth the risk.
I snatch a bite and retreat to eat.
That little? Enough for one.

lines.zh: 同伴也看见了，我得快点。
lines.en: A packmate saw it too. Quick.
You're standing too close. I daren't.
I circle round to approach from the other side.
Hungry all night — this matters.
Put it down. Then two steps back.
The bump rolled me half over.
I'm light. One touch and I'm off.

lines.zh: 凯恩塔组的小猎手，就是我。
lines.en: The little hunter of the Kayenta beds — that's me.
The pack got scattered by that.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑出去一段。
lines.en: I slid a short way along the ground.
Don't crowd. The crack fits one.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，你退了吗？
lines.en: We knocked. Did you step back?
I shake my feathers and pretend nothing happened.
You've cut off my retreat.
I slip around your ankle.

lines.zh: 你也是夜里才出来的吗？
lines.en: Do you only come out at night too?
I've nothing much to offer.
Pressed together, we'd be warmer.

lines.zh: 有幼崽在的时候，得护着。
lines.en: With young ones, one must guard them.

lines.zh: 我只挑半血以下的下手。
lines.en: I only take those below half health.
The desert night is too cold.
When you call, I'll know.

lines.zh: 我们这一群，谁都不孤单。
lines.en: In this pack no one is alone.
Dawn's coming. We must hide.
Get through this night first.
I pick it up. Very light.
This feather, I'll keep.
I bite, then let go; it won't drag.
I bury it in the sand.
Yours? I won't.
One bite, to check.
Can't run fast carrying this.
I scratch a hole and bury it.
A packmate comes; I turn and run.
Even this. I want it.
It's limping.
The smell of blood is thickening.
Crouched low, wings tucked.
The pack has spread out.
This one's nearly half gone.
First, my way out.
It's at the cliff. Nowhere to run.
I shift half a step that way.
A short call to the pack.
There'll be food tonight.
Not yet. Let it weaken more.
Now. All of us.
I follow at a distance.
It turns; I flatten.
A packmate has gone round that side.

lines.zh: 它步子沉了，我加快速度。
lines.en: Its steps grow heavy; I speed up.

lines.zh: 它一低头，我的羽毛就收紧。
lines.en: When it lowers its head, my feathers tighten.
The sand is cold at night.

lines.zh: 夜里的脚步声，都是我的。
lines.en: Every night footstep here is mine.
Any closer and it'll notice.
I count how many steps it has left.
The wind has it confused.
Now. All together.
Don't let it reach open ground.
Almost within reach.
I leap and bite its hind leg.
Small teeth, but an accurate bite.

lines.zh: 我们几只分头咬，它顾不过来。
lines.en: We bite from all sides. It can't cover them.
Bite and back off. Never linger.
I dig into its back and climb.
It shook me off.
That bite went for the tendon.
Several of us pile on.
It's down and we're still biting.
The young are behind. Don't come.
Enough. Back into the rocks.
That's enough for one night.

lines.zh: 我从岩石的影子里走出来。
lines.en: I step out of the rock's shadow.
The sand is still cool.
I shake the dust from my feathers.
I know this butte.

lines.zh: 同伴陆续从裂缝里钻出来。
lines.en: One by one the pack comes out of the cracks.

lines.zh: 我先抬头看天，没有月亮。
lines.en: I look up. No moon.
The night is our time.

lines.zh: 我朝干燥的林子那边走。
lines.en: I head for the dry woodland.
There's blood on the wind.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，也能活很久。
lines.en: Something this small can still live long.
I run low to the ground.

lines.zh: 夜一落，我先沿着干河床走。
lines.en: Night falls; I follow the dry riverbed first.
My call is thin.
This stretch is ours tonight.
Fire neared and my feathers curled.

lines.zh: 我从岩上摔下来，翻了两圈。
lines.en: I fell from the rock and rolled twice.

lines.zh: 水淹过我的头，我蹬不动。
lines.en: Water's over my head. I can't kick.
The blast threw me into the sand.
Something's lodged in my side.
That light made my legs weak.

lines.zh: 好几个晚上没吃东西了。
lines.en: Several nights without food.

lines.zh: 雷打在沙上，我一跳就僵了。
lines.en: Lightning hit the sand; I jumped and froze.

lines.zh: 这里没有地，也没有石头。
lines.en: No ground here. No stones.
